headlines.title: I get £4,062 a year and am trying my best - here's what I want from the Budget
headlines.summary: People on a range of incomes from £4,062 to £150,000 a year tell the BBC what they want to see in this year's Budget.

headlines.title: Mercedes-Benz cuts 2026 profit outlook amid China market struggles
headlines.summary: Mercedes-Benz now expects its 2026 core profit to remain flat at €5.8 billion, abandoning its earlier forecast of 15% growth, further signaling the severe structural crisis threatening Germany's automotive industry.

headlines.title: DW
headlines.summary: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

headlines.title: The US and Canada are talking trade. That doesn’t mean they re near a deal.
headlines.summary: Washington and Ottawa have intensified their discussions over the past week, but have yet to offer concessions.

headlines.title: Minimum wage set to rise but 18-20 year-olds will not get bigger increase
headlines.summary: Chancellor John Healey will reveal the new pay rates in the Budget, and has also announced measures to help households with the cost of living.

headlines.title: TikTok parent company founder tops China's rich list amid AI boom
headlines.summary: Zhang Yiming has reclaimed his position as China's richest person, with a €89.4 billion fortune driven by AI, as the country's technology sector booms while traditional industries struggle.

headlines.title: Quebec’s separatist leader threatens to play spoiler at Carney’s EU summit
headlines.summary: Premier Paul St-Pierre Plamondon says Ottawa would rather he “serve shrimp cocktail” at a function than stage one, and alleges a “serious lack of respect.”

headlines.title: China's families are now supporting more old people than kids
headlines.summary: The latest figures mark a major milestone as Beijing grapples with an ageing population.

headlines.title: Dutch chip firm Besi's shares jump as Applied Materials moves to double stake
headlines.summary: Shares in Dutch chip equipment maker Besi jumped on Tuesday after US rival Applied Materials announced plans to lift its holding to roughly 20% from 9%, tightening ties built around technology used to make AI hardware.

headlines.title: EU eyes global tax deal revenue to boost next budget
headlines.summary: European Council President António Costa is pushing national capitals to agree new EU-wide levies to finance the budget.

headlines.title: Donald Trump's biggest economic problem looks strangely familiar
headlines.summary: Donald Trump heads into the US midterm elections with an issue similar to his political foe Joe Biden.

headlines.title: AI chip boom tripled South Korea's economic growth in the third quarter
headlines.summary: South Korea's economy grew faster than expected in the third quarter. However, analysts warned that its heavy reliance on the chip industry leaves the country vulnerable to a slowdown in global AI spending.

headlines.title: EU prepares for a grim future with new climate-proofing law
headlines.summary: The Commission says it's not giving up on slashing emissions but acknowledges that's no longer enough.

headlines.title: Rise in sales of radios and tinned foods, say retailers, after call to stock up
headlines.summary: Figures obtained by BBC Newsnight show large spikes in sales of torches, radios and power banks.

headlines.title: EU Inc: Why the Commission's perfect startup plan might be falling apart
headlines.summary: EU Inc, the Commission’s promise to strengthen the EU’s startup market and keep startups from moving abroad, is facing roadblocks that make its adoption by 2026 difficult. Will the 28th regime survive?

headlines.title: Frontex soll soziale Medien auf Hinweise zu illegaler Migration überwachen
headlines.summary: Die EU-Grenzschutzagentur Frontex soll künftig soziale Netzwerke beobachten dürfen, um Informationen über Migrationsbewegungen zu sammeln.

headlines.title: 'An annoying buzz': The search for stealthier drones
headlines.summary: As drone deliveries become more commonplace, their makers are looking for ways to make them quieter.

headlines.title: Microsoft offers around 60,000 employees voluntary buyouts
headlines.summary: The offer will be made available to employees on select teams across the US, Canada, India and the United Kingdom at level 70 and below, meaning some senior staff could be included. Around 60,000 employees are reported to be eligible.

headlines.title: EIB to sign framework deal with Canada on critical raw materials
headlines.summary: Deal marks concrete step toward closer ties between the EU and Canada.

headlines.title: Landline switchover could cut people off in emergency, minister warned
headlines.summary: Plans to switch to digital landlines by January could leave remote areas of the UK vulnerable, MPs say.

trend_headline: 메르세데스 벤츠의 실적 전망 하향과 독일 자동차의 위기
summary: 메르세데스-벤츠가 중국 시장의 구조적 부진을 이유로 2026년 핵심 이익 전망치를 대폭 하향 조정하며 독일 자동차 산업의 위기를 방증했습니다. 반면 네덜란드 반도체 장비사 베시(Besi)는 어플라이드 머티어리얼즈의 지분 확대 소식에 급등하며 AI 인프라 중심의 섹터 차별화가 심화되고 있습니다.
key_points: 메르세데스-벤츠, 중국 시장 부진으로 2026년 코어 이익 전망치 15% 성장 전망을 철회하고 58억 유로로 동결
